csat.name: csat
csat.description: Share of good scores among all good or bad survey answers

definition.formula: ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN (m.SCORE IN ('good', 'bad')) AND (m.ANSWERED_AT >= DATEADD(DAY, -30, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) AND (m.CHANNEL = 'store') THEN CASE WHEN m.SCORE = 'good' THEN 1 END END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN (m.SCORE IN ('good', 'bad')) AND (m.ANSWERED_AT >= DATEADD(DAY, -30, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) AND (m.CHANNEL = 'store') THEN CASE WHEN m.SCORE IN ('good', 'bad') THEN 1 END END), 0), 1)

examples.question: What is the CSAT for store surveys over the last 30 days?
examples.sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN SCORE = 'good' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) FROM TPCDS.PUBLIC.CUSTOMER_SURVEY WHERE SCORE IN ('good','bad') AND CHANNEL = 'store' AND ANSWERED_AT >= DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

definition.population: Survey answers with a good or bad score
